title: Brookes Bodega

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Yo yo yo! Did Agent Beef send you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yo yo yo! Did Agent Beef send you?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: That's what I call him, cos he got beef with EVERYONE. Even me dawg! Imagine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I call him, cos he got beef with EVERYONE. Even me dawg! Imagine.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Look, this never happened before, but, for the first time, one of my businesses didn't fly. You know why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, this never happened before, but, for the first time, one of my businesses didn't fly. You know why?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Whoa whoa whoa! I know you're joking, but watch it there friendo. Your business reputation is all that matters in Nivalis. My rep already took a knock. I don't need your nega-tronity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa whoa whoa! I know you're joking, but watch it there friendo. Your business reputation is all that matters in Nivalis. My rep already took a knock. I don't need your nega-tronity.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Right! Bad luck. Unrelated... if you're ever selling salami sandwiches, DO NOT ignore the "best before" date on the meat. Trust me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! Bad luck. Unrelated... if you're ever selling salami sandwiches, DO NOT ignore the "best before" date on the meat. Trust me.
He fuckin' WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: This is what he meant when he said he would "fix it"? He's giving you my CLICC?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is what he meant when he said he would "fix it"? He's giving you my CLICC?!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Cold-hearted. Stamping on my dreams. A knife in my back and a kick in the balls at the same time. And a slap to the face. Yo, you're like an untrustworthy octopus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cold-hearted. Stamping on my dreams. A knife in my back and a kick in the balls at the same time. And a slap to the face. Yo, you're like an untrustworthy octopus.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Whatever. I ain't giving you my CLICC. That's the end of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. I ain't giving you my CLICC. That's the end of it.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Hey, listen, I got an idea! You go back to Teleshko. Right? You're gonna tell him I got an alternative.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, listen, I got an idea! You go back to Teleshko. Right? You're gonna tell him I got an alternative.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: My hacked license will show the profit from Brooke's Bodega. You keep the license, but I keep the credit score. Everybody wins, and we pull one over on old Agent Beef!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My hacked license will show the profit from Brooke's Bodega. You keep the license, but I keep the credit score. Everybody wins, and we pull one over on old Agent Beef!
Agent Beef?
Imagine.
Yeah, he's bad news.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have no idea what you're doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have no idea what you're doing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have no idea what you're doing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have no idea what you're doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bad luck?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Teleshko says you have a business license for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Teleshko says you have a business license for me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Teleshko says you have a business license for me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Teleshko says you have a business license for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just doing what he told me to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just doing what he told me to.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm just doing what he told me to.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm just doing what he told me to.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry man, it's my permit now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry man, it's my permit now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry man, it's my permit now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry man, it's my permit now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm... not an untrustworthy octopus.
Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think you have a choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think you have a choice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think you have a choice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think you have a choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.
Why don't you tell him?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: This could work out for the best for both of us! Just hear me out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This could work out for the best for both of us! Just hear me out.
Fine. I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: You go back to Teleshko and tell him I already sold the CLICC to my brother. Right? You gotta make him believe you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You go back to Teleshko and tell him I already sold the CLICC to my brother. Right? You gotta make him believe you.
And then?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: And then when he checks out my story, he'll see my brother died last week in that big hive quake.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then when he checks out my story, he'll see my brother died last week in that big hive quake.
Your brother died?
I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: I didn't like him anyway. He owed me money. Look, the point is, when Beef sees my brother died, he'll issue another CLICC to you. He got that power if he thinks the original is lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't like him anyway. He owed me money. Look, the point is, when Beef sees my brother died, he'll issue another CLICC to you. He got that power if he thinks the original is lost.
And then?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: And then you get the new CLICC, but I still got one too. I get a Skimmer to rip the debt records off my CLICC but keep the profit ledger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then you get the new CLICC, but I still got one too. I get a Skimmer to rip the debt records off my CLICC but keep the profit ledger.
I don't get it.
That doesn't sound legal.
I'm not sure about this.
Alright. I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Here's the pitch. Convince Teleshko I gave my bro the license. He thinks it's lost in a crater in the ocean. You get the new license, I get a hacked record that makes me look like a business genius. Which I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here's the pitch. Convince Teleshko I gave my bro the license. He thinks it's lost in a crater in the ocean. You get the new license, I get a hacked record that makes me look like a business genius. Which I am.
I'll talk to Teleshko.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe... I have to think about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe... I have to think about this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe... I have to think about this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe... I have to think about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here we go...
